structure.AGENTS.md: How to work on this project: commands, structure, rules (read by AI assistants)
structure.MEDHA_STYLE.md: The Medha style guide every contributor and assistant follows

sections.title: Working with AI assistants
sections.body:
`AGENTS.md` and `MEDHA_STYLE.md` are the single source of truth for how code in this project is written. Claude Code (`CLAUDE.md`), Gemini (`GEMINI.md`), GitHub Copilot (`.github/copilot-instructions.md`), Cursor (`.cursor/rules/`) and Windsurf (`.windsurf/rules/`) are all pointed at them; Codex and other tools read `AGENTS.md` directly.

`prompts/` has ready-made prompts for common tasks: copy one into your assistant and fill in the blanks. `{{ runScript }} check:style` enforces the visual rules whichever tool wrote the code.
